description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_emp_education' database table and includes properties such as employee reference, education reference, institute, major, year, score, start date, and end date. It also contains getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: Represents the educational background of an employee, including references to Employee and Education entities, and details such as institute, major, years, score, start and end dates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the EmployeeEducation record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the EmployeeEducation record.

methods.name: setEducation
methods.description: Associates an Education entity with this EmployeeEducation.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this education record.

methods.name: getInstitute
methods.description: Returns the name of the institute where the education was obtained.

methods.name: setInstitute
methods.description: Sets the name of the institute.

methods.name: getMajor
methods.description: Returns the major subject of the education.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: setYear
methods.description: Sets the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: getScore
methods.description: Returns the score or grade achieved.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the education period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the education period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the education period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the education period.
